result.summary: The import still returns not_found and leaves the message uncreated, so the client-facing behavior is fine. The patch drops Failed to import record to info for every attachment entity_not_found, including an id the non-consistent lookup missed, and the tests never assert that choice on the real path.

problems.title: Info covers more than a wrong-customer id
problems.detail: A missing attachment id and a different-customer attachment both become entity_not_found. The batch get does not use a consistent read, so a just-uploaded id can miss and will no longer be an error log.

problems.title: Tests do not prove the log change
problems.detail: The unit test calls fail with logLevel info, so the attachment check never runs. The litest only checks the not_found result, which this path already returned.

problems.title: Shared recorder can silence any failure
problems.detail: logLevel is a general option on recordFailed. The different-customer case is already logged at info in preparePendingAttachments, which is where the two cases are still distinct.

result.betterFix: Use a consistent read for this lookup. Choose info only on the different-customer branch before both cases become entity_not_found, and leave a missing attachment id at error.
